title: Phase 2: Server modernization (Django LTS + ML stack replacement)
description: Follow-up to Phase 0/1 (docker-compose WSL fix + security hardening, commit a39f881). Zero test coverage existed before Phase 1 added minimal DRF smoke tests per app (24 tests) - use those as the regression signal for this phase. See ~/.claude/plans/async-cooking-globe.md for full Phase 1 writeup and rationale.
design: User explicitly chose: replace bert-extractive-summarizer rather than upgrade-in-place or leave pinned. Django jump should go through django-organizations/dj-rest-auth/django_celery_beat/django-filter/django_extensions compat checks per version, not straight 3.1->5.2. Bundle the Python 3.8 base image bump with the ML rework since the pinned ML wheels are tied to that CPython ABI.
